category_title: Students who systematically decompose multi-step problems using strategic scaffolding
student_description: This student tackles complex multi-step word problems by systematically decomposing them and focusing heavily on the meaning of quantities. They rely on flexible scaffolding tools but require explicit cognitive apprenticeship—including think-aloud modeling and persistent initial guidance—to internalize these strategies and eventually fade out the physical tools.

criteria.rationale: Because complex strategic scaffolds require time to internalize, these students need persistent, active teacher guidance during the initial acquaintance phase.
criteria.check: The long-term plan includes a phase of persistent, active tutor guidance specifically focused on helping the student master the scaffolding tool before expecting independent application.

criteria.rationale: These students successfully internalize tools through a cognitive apprenticeship model, eventually transitioning from physical tools to mental strategies at their own pace.
criteria.check: The long-term plan outlines a clear progression from guided use to independent use, explicitly allowing the student to fade out or drop the physical scaffolding tool when they are ready.
